title: Savings Consultation After Issue Resolution
purpose: Show how an agent confirms the current service issue is complete before providing fact-based product information.

steps.label: Start follow-up consultation
steps.description: Establish the customer and current call business context.

steps.label: Customer explains the consultation goal
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Hi, thanks for helping me with my account last time. I have a question about automatic savings.
steps.description: The customer states the goal; positive service feedback and the savings theme enter the transcript together.

steps.label: Agent invites the customer to explain
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I’m happy to help. What would you like to understand about the savings rules?
steps.description: The agent invites a clear goal while assistance waits for more context.

steps.label: Customer explains the savings goal
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: I’m building an emergency fund, and I’d like something simple that I can adjust when my income changes.
steps.description: The customer adds a personal goal; the platform retains the savings theme while waiting for business-state confirmation.

steps.label: Agent clarifies the product question
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: So you want an automatic rule that is easy to change, rather than a fixed commitment. Is that right?
steps.description: The agent restates the goal so any follow-up assistance stays aligned with the conversation.

steps.label: Customer confirms the need
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Exactly. I want to know how the rule works, what it costs each month, and how I can stop it if I need to.
steps.description: The customer asks for product facts and cost; the platform can prepare approved guidance retrieval.

steps.label: Confirm the service issue is complete
steps.description: Only a business workflow event can change complaint authority; a positive customer statement does not resolve it automatically.

steps.label: Agent moves into product information
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I’ve confirmed there isn’t an open service issue to resolve on this call. I’ll check the approved savings details for you now.
steps.description: The business workflow confirms the service state and the agent explains that approved product facts will be checked.

steps.label: Customer asks a specific question
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Yes, please tell me the monthly cost and what I need to do to get started.
steps.description: The question is specific to product cost and enrollment conditions, triggering the follow-up assistance assessment.

steps.label: Show evidence-backed product assistance
steps.description: The agent sees a follow-up option only after eligibility, product facts, guidance, and explanation checks pass.

steps.label: Deliver assistance to the agent desktop
Agent desktop acknowledges the display
steps.description: Record that the browser applied the complete assistance snapshot.

steps.label: End the call
steps.description: End the live session and withdraw real-time assistance.

steps.label: Generate the call summary
steps.description: Save the customer request, sentiment, themes, and evidence references.

steps.label: Verify retry safety
steps.description: Run the same post-call job again without creating a duplicate record.
